thought.text: All validation checks are complete and the environment is cleaned up. Let me summarize my findings.

reasoning_content:
Cleanup complete. Now let me summarize the evidence for the final report:

1. **Prerequisites**: Node.js v22.23.3 (satisfies "Node.js 22") is installed at /opt/node22, and is symlinked into /usr/local/bin. npm 10.9.9. ✓
2. **`npm ci`**: node_modules exists (top-level packages 317, including dependencies totaling 382), `./node_modules/.bin/next --version` → Next.js v15.3.0. Git working tree is clean (no uncommitted changes other than node_modules/.next/out being ignored). ✓
3. **`npm run lint`**: Exit 0, "✔ No ESLint warnings or errors". ✓
4. **`npm run build`**: Exit 0, compiled successfully, type-checked, exported 10 static pages to /workspace/out/. ✓ (re-ran it myself to confirm reproducibility)
5. **`npm run dev`**: Dev server ready in 1803ms at http://localhost:3000. Confirmed HTTP 200 with correct titles on all 6 routes. Non-existent pages return 404. ✓
6. **Static export**: Served out/ with a simple Node server, all .html pages returned 200 with correct titles. 404.html works. _next assets exist (1.6M total). ✓

The installation is complete and functioning exactly as documented in the guide. Result: success.

Inspection confirmed: (1) Node.js v22.23.3 installed at /opt/node22 with symlinks in /usr/local/bin, satisfying the guide's 'Voraussetzung: Node.js 22'; npm 10.9.9. (2) Project files, package.json (scripts dev/build/start/lint), node_modules (317 top-level entries, next 15.3.0 binary present) and build artifact out/ all exist, matching the installation summary; git working tree clean. Behavioral validation: I re-ran every documented guide command. `npm run lint` exited 0 with no warnings/errors. `npm run build` exited 0, compiled and type-checked successfully, and re-exported the 10 static pages to /workspace/out/ \u2014 proving the build step is reproducible, not just a one-time success. `npm run dev` started in ~1.8s on http://localhost:3000; curl returned HTTP 200 with the correct <title> on all six application routes and HTTP 404 for an unknown route, confirming full routing and rendering. I additionally verified the static export is deployable as claimed by serving /workspace/out/ with a minimal Node HTTP server on port 8080: index.html and all five section HTML pages returned 200 with correct titles, and the 404 fallback worked. Limitations: python3 was unavailable in the container, so the static export was served with a small Node script instead (equivalent for validation purposes); direct URL-path access (e.g. /ea-repository without .html) requires a web server with clean-URL rewrite rules, which is expected for a static export and not a defect. I performed no installation, repair, or file edits beyond running the documented scripts; all temporary servers and files I created were removed, and I verified ports 3000/8080 are released. All evidence objectively supports that the installation is complete and operational per the guide."}
